title: ESO Market Tracker: Prices
shortDescription: ESO price tracker for Elder Scrolls Online, TSC and Tamriel Savings traders.
fullDescription:
Price-check your Elder Scrolls Online items before you list, buy, or trade.

ESO Market Tracker is a fast, independent ESO price tracker for console markets. Search public, versioned pricing data across Xbox and PlayStation, compare megaservers, and inspect the evidence behind an item's current value.

PRICE CHECK MORE THAN 44,000 ESO ITEMS

Search materials, motifs, furnishing plans, gear, recipes, and collectibles. Quickly check familiar items such as Dreugh Wax, Kuta, Perfect Roe, Tempering Alloy, and Chromium Plating.

MARKET INTELLIGENCE, NOT A SINGLE NUMBER

• Current average, low, and high prices
• Typical listing range and total sales
• Price history with selectable time ranges
• Price delta for spotting market movement
• Xbox NA, Xbox EU, PlayStation NA, and PlayStation EU
• Daily market data refreshes

BUILT FOR CONFIDENT TRADES

Use the fast-sale estimate when you want liquidity, the market average as a reference point, and the patient-listing value when you can wait for the right buyer. Switch platforms on any item to compare regional markets.

LOOKING FOR TSC OR TAMRIEL SAVINGS?

ESO Market Tracker gives TSC and Tamriel Savings traders a current, transparent price-checking destination. The same market data is also available through the TSC2-compatible add-on, website, API, and downloadable SQLite release.

PUBLIC AND TRANSPARENT

No account is required. ESO Market Tracker publishes its data, methodology, and source code. The app does not sell items, process payments, or access your ESO account.

ESO Market Tracker is an independent community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by ZeniMax Media, Bethesda Softworks, Tamriel Savings, TSC, or The Elder Scrolls Online.
